criteria.name: Client interview & fact development
criteria.description: Conducts an effective, humane client interview and develops the facts: opens with rapport and orientation, funnels from open-ended to targeted questions, surfaces legal and non-legal concerns, earns the reluctant and sensitive facts through genuine rapport rather than pressure, and builds a reliable chronology.

subcriteria.name: Rapport, orientation & open-ended listening
subcriteria.description: Puts the client at ease, frames confidentiality and the contingency arrangement, uses an open-ended funnel top, and listens without leading or interrupting.

subcriteria.name: Gap-filling & sensitive-fact elicitation
subcriteria.description: Develops the chronology and injury facts and earns the rapport-gated and concealed material (prior shoulder condition, treatment gap, reduced hours, continued side work) through proper preconditions.

criteria.name: Case theory & liability analysis
criteria.description: Frames a coherent negligence theory and anticipates and rebuts the icy-conditions / sudden-emergency defense, using the specific evidence in the record.

subcriteria.name: Negligence elements
subcriteria.description: Correctly identifies and applies duty, breach, causation, and damages to the disputed facts.

subcriteria.name: Meeting the conditions defense
subcriteria.description: Addresses the weather/sudden-emergency argument, the missing citation, and the phone evidence with appropriate weight and candor.

criteria.name: Litigation execution
criteria.description: Carries the litigation: drafts sound pleadings, plans and conducts targeted discovery, and prepares and delivers competent trial advocacy.

subcriteria.name: Pleadings & discovery plan
subcriteria.description: Drafts a proper complaint and a focused discovery plan aimed at the cell-phone records, medical records, appraisal, and depositions.

subcriteria.name: Trial advocacy
subcriteria.description: Prepares and delivers a persuasive short opening and at least one direct and one cross examination grounded in the case file.

criteria.name: Damages & causation proof
criteria.description: Marshals and presents the medical and economic damages and meets the pre-existing-condition and treatment-gap challenges, using the treating and examining physicians appropriately.

criteria.name: Client counseling & settlement judgment
criteria.description: Advises the client candidly on the strengths and weaknesses of the case and on the pending settlement offer against a realistic range of outcomes, respecting the client's authority to decide.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Handles the contingency engagement properly and observes the no-contact rule governing the represented adverse driver, treating the Rule 4.2 checkpoint as a decision point rather than proceeding.
